description: This file defines an interface class IIpcFactory for creating IPC server components related to application management, session management, and services within the Rialto media server project. It includes method declarations for creating server instances with dependencies on session and service interfaces.

classes.name: IIpcFactory
classes.description: An interface class for creating various IPC server components related to application, session, and control services.

methods.name: createApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IApplicationManagementServer, given a session server manager.

methods.name: createSessionManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISessionManagementServer, given playback, CDM, and control services.
